concerns.text: FR-010 requires adjustment of raw p‑values using the lag‑1 autocorrelation (Pyper & Peterman) on the full continuous series, but T004 implements Thomson’s Multitaper Method instead, leaving the spec‑mandated method uncovered.

SC-001 specifies that the full 20‑year correlation analysis must complete within 6 h and ≤ 7 GB RAM, yet no task measures or asserts this performance constraint for the analysis stage (only sync‑stage benchmarking exists).

SC-003 demands that validation uses the Bonferroni‑corrected p‑values (as per the spec) after autocorrelation adjustment. T005’s validation report flags significance using Holm‑Bonferroni, which diverges from the required Bonferroni method, so the spec’s statistical requirement is not fully satisfied.
